title: USAspending FY2025 geographic federal award transaction obligation aggregates
limitations: Aggregated federal award transaction obligations over FY2025 (October 1 2024 through September 30 2025), not federal cash outlays or program impacts.
Place of performance, not recipient headquarters or where economic benefits ultimately accrue.
Negative transaction adjustments and deobligations can yield negative published aggregates; values are never clipped to zero.
USAspending coverage is subject to agency reporting delays, corrections, exclusions and revisions.
Missing geography is unavailable and never interpreted as a zero-dollar obligation.
Territorial and unknown geography codes are retained only in raw evidence; publish 52 Census reference geographies where source reports them.
